name: Los Grandes

window.timezone_note: OE/gol.gg date stamps are source-native (typically UTC calendar dates). LoL Esports API event starts are converted separately in verification notes.

provenance.source: Oracle's Elixir public yearly CSVs + gol.gg thin maps after OE cutoff
notes: Detailed player/combat stats (KDA, GD@15, damageshare, firstPick side-order, off-meta shares) use OE only through oe_detailed_through.
Match W/L, international map results, and Elo strength include gol.gg maps after OE cutoff when OE lag; those rows lack GD@15/firstPick.
Missing fields are null; never filled with 0. Thin gol.gg rows are never treated as full player-stat coverage.
Academy/ERL teams are separate from majors; aliases never merge Challengers/Academy into the main org.
OE public Drive download may be quota-blocked; refresh attempts are recorded in meta.refresh_attempt.

grades.strength_basis: percentile of sequential hierarchical Elo among home-league peers (fallback: tier peers)
grades.drafting_basis: percentile of opponent-adjusted residual proxy among tier peers — NOT causal draft quality

international.note: International leagues only (Worlds/MSI/EWC/etc). Null events omitted.

golddiffat15.note: GD@15 excludes gol.gg thin post-OE maps (field unavailable there).

power_rank.scope: home league UNK teams with ≥8 season maps
power_rank.metric: sequential hierarchical Elo strength (descriptive rating, not future guarantee)

summary: Los Grandes (UNK) in 2026: 5-3 maps (62.5% WR). Match results through 2026-11-05; OE detailed stats through 2026-10-24. International: Worlds 5-3. Strength grade reflects sequential Elo within peers; drafting grade is an opponent-adjusted residual proxy, not causal draft quality.

season_proxy.label: draft_proxy
season_proxy.note: Opponent-adjusted map residual vs pre-map Elo expectation. Not causal draft quality.

recent_proxy.label: draft_proxy
recent_proxy.note: Opponent-adjusted map residual vs pre-map Elo expectation. Not causal draft quality.

drafting.analysis: Drafting grade S is a Polyverse proxy from opponent-adjusted map residuals (actual result minus pre-map Elo win probability). Positive residual means outperforming strength expectation; it can reflect draft, prep, or variance — not proven draft skill.

off_meta_definition.rule: Champion share of all season pro games in that role < 2%

gaps: Team GD@15 unavailable for some/all maps
No roster rows meeting min games
Match results include 8 maps through 2026-11-05 but OE detailed player/combat stats only through 2026-10-24 (8 post-OE thin maps).
